items.prompt: Name one source of evidence about past climate.

steps: Ice cores and tree rings record past climate.

items.answer: Old air and layers showing past temperatures and gases

steps: More carbon dioxide links to warmer temperatures.

steps: Burning fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide.

steps: Both are rising in current data.

items.prompt: Explain how ice cores give evidence about past climate.
items.answer: They trap old air and layers that record past temperatures and gas levels

steps: Fossil fuel burning releases carbon dioxide.
